_doc: Add a founder by appending to the array. Order doesn't matter — render-founders.js sorts alphabetically by handle. Cap at 1000 entries; price ladder rule says price hikes to $14.99 at unlock #5,001 but only the first 1,000 paid unlocks get a public-wall slot.

_schema.platform: ig | x | name (optional, defaults to handle prefix)
_schema.unlocked_at: YYYY-MM-DD (optional, kept private — only count is shown)
